summary: DT Cloud Star Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing a $75,000 trust deposit on August 20, 2026, extending its deadline to complete an initial business combination to August 26, 2026. The company previously extended multiple times under an amended Trust Agreement with Wilmington Trust, borrowing $75,000 from sponsor DT Cloud Star Management via unsecured promissory note in October 2025. These extensions keep the SPAC alive and signal ongoing search for a target, though no deal announced. Watch for a definitive business combination or liquidation if extensions lapse.
